title: Cannabidiol synergizes with methotrexate to attenuate rheumatoid arthritis via STAT3/NF-kappaB signalling-mediated M1 macrophage polarization.
authors: Xu, Jiahe; Wang, Zhaoran; Geng, Qishun; Wen, Chaoying; Jiao, Yi; Deng, Tiantian; Shi, Tong; Wang, Yan; Deng, Tingting; Xiao, Cheng
one_liner_zh: 该文研究CBD与MTX联用治疗类风湿关节炎的STAT3/NF-kB信号通路机制，虽含分子对接但核心为药效与炎症通路，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Methotrexate (MTX) is the anchor drug for rheumatoid arthritis (RA) treatment, but its clinical application is limited by dose-dependent adverse events, such as hepatotoxicity and gastrointestinal intolerance, and incomplete efficacy in some patients. Cannabidiol (CBD) is a nonpsychotropic cannabinoid that has powerful therapeutic efficacy in alleviating pain and inflammation, as well as favourable safety and tolerability profiles. However, whether CBD can synergize with MTX to enhance therapeutic outcomes and mitigate toxicity remains unclear. This study aimed to investigate the synergistic efficacy, safety profile, and underlying molecular mechanism of the CBD-MTX combination in the treatment of RA. METHODS: Mice were randomly divided into 8 groups (n = 5 per group): a normal control group (NC), a model control group (MC), 3 MTX monotherapy groups (low/medium/high dose), and 3 CBD + MTX combination groups (low/medium/high dose). Arthritis severity was assessed by clinical scoring and micro-CT. Systemic safety was evaluated via histopathological examination of the liver, kidney, and testis. Flow cytometry, ELISA and Western blotting were used to validate the mechanisms involved. Network pharmacology and molecular docking were used to predict potential targets. RESULTS: Compared with MTX monotherapy, the CBD-MTX combination had dose-dependent synergistic effects, significantly attenuating joint swelling, inflammation, and bone erosion. The medium-dose combination approached the efficacy of high-dose MTX (dose-sparing effect). CBD mitigated MTX-induced testicular toxicity and spermatogenic failure. Mechanistically, the combination suppressed M1 macrophage polarization and proinflammatory cytokine (TNF-alpha, IL-6, and IL-1beta) secretion by inhibiting STAT3 and NF-kappaB signalling (downregulation of p-STAT3 and p-NF-kappaB p65). CONCLUSION: The CBD-MTX combination exerts superior antiarthritic effects by inhibiting STAT3/NF-kappaB-mediated M1 macrophage polarization and protecting against MTX-induced reproductive toxicity. This study provides a preclinical rationale for this novel combination strategy in RA management.
abstract_zh: 背景：甲氨蝶呤（Methotrexate, MTX）是类风湿关节炎（rheumatoid arthritis, RA）治疗的锚定药物，但其临床应用受限于剂量依赖性不良事件，如肝毒性和胃肠道不耐受，以及部分患者疗效不完全。大麻二酚（Cannabidiol, CBD）是一种非精神活性大麻素，在缓解疼痛和炎症方面具有强大的治疗功效，且具有良好的安全性和耐受性。然而，CBD是否能与MTX协同增强治疗效果并减轻毒性仍不清楚。本研究旨在探讨CBD-MTX联合治疗RA的协同疗效、安全性及潜在分子机制。方法：小鼠随机分为8组（每组n=5）：正常对照组（NC）、模型对照组（MC）、3个MTX单药治疗组（低/中/高剂量）和3个CBD+MTX联合治疗组（低/中/高剂量）。关节炎严重程度通过临床评分和micro-CT评估。全身安全性通过肝脏、肾脏和睾丸的组织病理学检查评估。流式细胞术、ELISA和Western blotting用于验证相关机制。网络药理学和分子对接用于预测潜在靶点。结果：与MTX单药治疗相比，CBD-MTX联合治疗具有剂量依赖性协同效应，显著减轻关节肿胀、炎症和骨侵蚀。中剂量联合治疗接近高剂量MTX的疗效（剂量节省效应）。CBD减轻了MTX诱导的睾丸毒性和生精障碍。机制上，联合治疗通过抑制STAT3和NF-kappaB信号通路（下调p-STAT3和p-NF-kappaB p65）抑制M1巨噬细胞极化和促炎细胞因子（TNF-alpha、IL-6和IL-1beta）分泌。结论：CBD-MTX联合治疗通过抑制STAT3/NF-kappaB介导的M1巨噬细胞极化并保护MTX诱导的生殖毒性，发挥更优的抗关节炎效应。本研究为RA管理中这一新型联合策略提供了临床前依据。
